description: This file contains unit tests for device type checking functions, specifically testing 'isMobileDevice' against mocked device objects with different 'environment' properties.

methods.name: should return true for mobile devices
methods.description: Test case checking if 'isMobileDevice' returns true for a device with environment as Mobile.

methods.name: should return false for non mobile devices
methods.description: Test case checking if 'isMobileDevice' returns false for a device with environment as Web.

ctags.name: device
ctags.pattern: /^    const device = { environment: Environment.Mobile } as jest.Mocked<MobileDeviceInterface>$/

ctags.name: device
ctags.pattern: /^    const device = { environment: Environment.Web } as jest.Mocked<DeviceInterface>$/
